opening.argument: The speaker directly promotes Bit Club Network's mining contracts while presenting participation as a source of income for a broad audience. He identifies himself as part of the network and connects its planned Bitcoin activity to those contracts, stating that he is “within the Bit Club network, which I am a part of, that we are actually launching Bitcoin..on top of our mining contracts.” He then promises that “there's gonna be an income stream for the masses of partaking in this movement.” His enthusiasm extends to urging that Mike Tyson be introduced to the network, showing an effort to expand exposure to the promoted opportunity.
